plan.name: Fictional bookmark search
plan.goal: Add keyword search to a fictional bookmark manager.

tasks.title: Write the search design note
tasks.description: Describe search inputs, outputs and limits.
tasks.acceptance: The note lists inputs, outputs and at least one non-goal.

tasks.title: Implement keyword search
tasks.description: Add a search function that follows the design note.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests cover no match, one match and several matches.

tasks.title: Review the search change
tasks.description: Review correctness, privacy and test coverage of T2.
tasks.acceptance: Findings are listed with severity, or the review states none were found.

tasks.title: Decide whether to merge
tasks.description: A person reads the review and decides.
tasks.acceptance: The decision is recorded with complete or fail.
